newsitems.contents: 21 октября в MMORPG Lost Ark стартовало обновление «Бельгардин», главным событием которого стал рейд Теней «Бельгардин, Длань смерти». Предусмотрен и режим экспедиции, допускающий одиночное прохождение. Одним из главных нововведений стала механика долгого парирования. Во время определённых атак Бельгардина игроки смогут удерживать клавишу G, чтобы отражать удары босса. Кроме того, в рейде появилась система ограниченных возрождений, количество которых зависит от выбранной сложности. За прохождение можно получить новый тип экипировки — манжеты, которые усиливаются до 25-го уровня. Также разработчики подготовили дополнительные достижения, титулы, мелодии, трофеи и другие награды. newsitems.author: timmyopa
newsitems.contents: Heroes of Arkesia,Join Smilegate for a behind the scenes preview of the Guardianknight class before she devastates Arkesia on February 4. Q: What was your goal when designing this new class?We wanted to create a special class without relying on any of the existing options. This approach allowed us to explore what might normally seem like an impossible concept— a class that directly utilizes the power of Guardians. The Guardians that players encounter are consistently presented as massive beings capable of overwhelming, destructive attacks. Our top priority was to actively incorporate those defining traits into the Guardianknight class.We believed that the contrast between the Guardianknight’s seemingly delicate appearance and her overwhelming, unexpected power would provide players with a uniquely enjoyable experience. newsitems.title: Team Update: Combating RMT
newsitems.author: HardcoreHenry
newsitems.contents: Heroes of Arkesia, Combating bots and player-to-player real money transactions (RMT) is a key focus of our team. While many of our past actions have been focused on reducing the efficacy and number of bots to improve the player experience of every adventurer in Arkesia, we have also been developing measures to better identify and action against RMT at scale. Our team conducted a major ban wave targeting accounts that transacted large amounts of RMT Gold earlier this week. To accompany this ban wave, we wanted to take a moment to reiterate our stance on RMT and correct some misconceptions we’ve seen circulating in the community. While we can’t share all of the measures that our team is taking (as that would grant those attempting to break the rules an upper-hand), we can share a general look into those policies. newsitems.contents: Lost Ark is preparing to celebrate the two-year anniversary of its global launch, yet while it's done a lot of work to catch up to the Korean version of the game, developers Amazon Games and Smilegate are unlikely to ever quite reach a point of parity. In the wake of its most recent balance update and ahead of the much-anticipated Thaemine legion raid, PCGamesN speaks with Lost Ark community lead Roxanne Sabo about its current and future plans. newsitems.title: Lost Ark finally gets much-requested balance update, and new content
newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents: Lost Ark updates are something most big fans of Smilegate's stunning MMO look forward to, and they always spark conversation. Players have feedback to share regarding patches, whether they bring new content or highly requested balance changes, and the game's upcoming January patch is no exception as fans have waited to see it come to fruition for a while now. The developer now says the update is just about ready, and it'll push the global edition of Lost Ark closer to its Korean counterpart. Read the rest of the story...
